title: ever DAHLIA|Short Sleeve V Neck Knee Length Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant knee-length mother of the bride dress offers a flattering V-neck and short sleeves for a chic, modern look. The simple yet sophisticated design is perfect for any formal event, providing a comfortable fit without compromising on style. Ideal for those looking for a graceful and timeless appearance.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
